## Checklist

- [ ] Has the change been documented in `docs/` or `design-system` if it affects UX/Architecture?
- [ ] UI: Responsive behaviors verified for 375px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px
- [ ] UI: No horizontal scroll on mobile
- [ ] UI: Mobile navigation present for pages that use a desktop sidebar
- [ ] UI: Contrast and focus states checked (4.5:1 minimum for body text)
- [ ] If design changes were made, `ui-ux-pro-max --design-system` was run and `design-system/pages/*` updated
- [ ] Added/updated tests or visual regression checks where appropriate

Provide a short description of the change and any design decisions below.
